::: {#def-dbrnffrcistg .theorem}
## DBRNFFRCISTG model

A dyadic bipartite random network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (DBRNFFRCISTG) is a causal model $\mathcal{C}=(\mathcal{M},\mathcal{M}^{(\Gamma)})$ of a DBRNNPSEM $\mathcal{M}$ that satisfies the conditions of a BRNFFRCISTG, except that single-world independence takes each dyad, rather than each row, as a single variable: the one-step-ahead counterfactuals of the dyads are mutually independent, and independent of those of the other variables.
:::
